constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use redis on one supported Redis release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target Redis release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.
steps.title: Update the base image

steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.
steps.title: Align other image references

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.

rule.replacement: A redis image on a later supported release line
rule.summary: The Redis 6.2 release line is scheduled to stop receiving fixes from the vendor on 2027-04-01.
rule.title: Redis image release line 6.2 reaches end-of-life on 2027-04-01
